title: oreocarya suffruticosa var. typica
intro: Oreocarya suffruticosa var. typica, commonly known as "Typical Dwarf Oreocarya", is a plant species belonging to the Plantaginaceae family. It has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Oreocarya suffruticosa var. typica include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial activities, which can aid in protecting against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
